title: salvia verbenaca subsp. controversa
intro: Salvia verbenaca subsp. controversa, commonly known as Verbena-leaved sage, is a subspecies of the Salvia verbenaca plant, a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Salvia verbenaca subsp. controversa include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
